query: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure OCI revenue Q2 FY2027 fiscal quarter
normalized: cloud fiscal fy2027 infrastructure oci oracle q2 quarter revenue

output.content:
Oracle has not yet reported OCI (Cloud Infrastructure/IaaS) revenue for Q2 FY2027, the quarter ending November 30, 2026; its next earnings release is expected in mid-December 2026. [[1, 2]] 

Oracle’s Q2 FY2027 guidance is for **total cloud revenue**—OCI plus SaaS—to grow **65%–71% year over year in U.S. dollars**, rather than providing a standalone OCI-revenue dollar forecast. [[3]] 

For reference, OCI revenue in Q1 FY2027 was **$7.4 billion**, up **121% year over year**. [[3]]
